test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55b6389954346a9ed3a2239f18de00e3a0f5c7d77944cdbbfa4a2ae7080a829e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left, top-middle, bottom-middle and bottom-left elements (all 4 elements) are shifting in a clockwise direction.

Top-right, bottom-right and middle element are interchanging their position with each other.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Top-left symbol with bottom-right symbol and top-middle with bottom-middle symbols are interchanging their position.

All 3 diagonal symbols from top-right to bottom-left are shifting in an anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8ae03a59c1335ec7d56dc9740648a4d2f0903d6351005ba92e66343ebbaa82f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
